explanation: Ans. ( 1 ) N oble gases have large positive electron gain enthalpies because the electron has to enter the next higher principal quantum level leading to a very unstable electronic configuration. 16 Ans. ( 1 ) E lectron gain enthalpy of Oxygen or F luorine is less negative than that of the succeeding element. This is because when an electron is added to Oxygen or F luorine , the added electron goes to the smaller n = 2 quantum level and suffers significant repulsion from the other electrons present in this level. For n = 3 (S or Cl), the added electron occupies a larger region of space and the electron - electron repulsion is much less.

reason: - The electron has to enter the next higher principal quantum level leading to a very unstable electronic configuration.
